journey.name: pay onchain from primary balance
journey.description: Requires a funded compatible primary channel with no spendable onchain funds in Bitkit, automatic coin selection, and a separate regtest receiver. Repeat with Beignet and LDK Node providers. Use regtest funds only. This Android flow is not implemented on iOS yet.

actions.action: Scan the separate wallet's plain Bitcoin address and verify the amount screen shows the software source as Bitcoin
Tap Max and verify the amount accounts for the selected network fee
Continue to confirmation and select a higher network fee; if the amount no longer fits, verify payment is disabled and the recipient amount is unchanged
Return to the amount screen and choose an affordable amount, then approve the reviewed payment
Verify the payment uses the primary channel without asking for a Savings or Spending transfer or selecting insufficient onchain coins
While the transaction is pending, retry another send and verify the pending message prevents a duplicate wallet operation
Mine the required blocks, sync both wallets and verify the separate receiver gets exactly the approved amount and Bitkit shows one outgoing activity
